players.product: Cloud services for AI-related demand, Hy family foundation models (Hy3) and in-house AI compute infrastructure (IT equipment and data-centre capex)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenues RMB751.8 billion, up 14%; gross margin 56% (53%); profit attributable to equity holders RMB224.8 billion (+16%) and non-IFRS RMB259.6 billion (+17%). VAS RMB369.3 billion (+16%; domestic games RMB164.2 billion +18%, international games RMB77.4 billion +33%); Marketing Services RMB145.0 billion (+19%) on AI-powered ad targeting and closed-loop ads; FinTech and Business Services RMB229.4 billion (+8%), with Business Services up at a high-teens rate on domestic and international cloud demand including AI-related services. Q4 2025 revenues RMB194.4 billion (+13%), with Business Services growth accelerating to 22%.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenues RMB751.8 billion (+14%); gross margin 56%; Q4 2025 Business Services +22%

quarterly_data.signal: Cloud and AI (annual report): the chairman says Tencent Cloud achieved profit at scale due to increased enterprise demand for AI workloads, higher contributions from PaaS and SaaS products and an optimised supply chain; FinTech and Business Services gross margin rose to 51% from 47% on the growing scale of cloud services; general and administrative expenses rose 21% to RMB136.1 billion on higher R&D staff costs and depreciation driven by AI investments. Management cites the HY 3.0 large language model and AI products such as Yuanbao, WorkBuddy and QClaw as early signs that its AI investments, including top-tier AI talent and upgraded AI infrastructure, will unlock new opportunities.
quarterly_data.figure: FinTech and Business Services gross margin 51% (47%)

quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure and commitments (annual report): capital expenditures RMB79,198 million in 2025 (RMB76,760 million in 2024), of which RMB19,632 million in Q4 2025 (RMB12,983 million in Q3); Q4 capex payments RMB22.4 billion, primarily to support AI efforts. Contracted capital commitments RMB20,755 million at year-end (buildings RMB5,237 million, investments in investees RMB12,164 million, other capital assets RMB3,354 million), and other contracted commitments mainly for bandwidth, game licensing, media content and other technical services RMB55,190 million (RMB31,070 million). Net cash RMB107.1 billion at December 31, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 capex RMB79,198 million; other contracted commitments RMB55,190 million (RMB31,070 million)

quarterly_data.signal: Customer and supplier concentration (annual report): the five largest customers accounted for approximately 6.5% and the largest customer approximately 3.4% of 2025 revenues; the five largest suppliers accounted for approximately 18.8% and the largest supplier approximately 4.4% of total purchases; no single customer reached 10% of revenues. Revenues from commercial arrangements with associates and joint ventures were approximately RMB48,089 million in FinTech and Business Services, RMB4,278 million in Marketing Services and RMB4,320 million in other services.
quarterly_data.figure: five largest customers 6.5% of revenues; five largest suppliers 18.8% of purchases, largest 4.4%
